_comment: The compose-ai-tools Gradle plugin coordinate this extension is built against.
In the monorepo this was derived from .release-please-manifest.json, which only
worked because the plugin and the extension shared a version and a release train.
Split apart they do not, so the compatibility pin is explicit and reviewable here.
`composeAiPlugin` is the version scripts/generate-version.mjs bakes into
BUNDLED_PLUGIN_VERSION — what the extension asks Gradle to apply when it injects
the plugin into a user's build. Bump it in its own PR when adopting a new plugin
release, so the adoption is a reviewable change rather than a side effect of a
release train. The PLUGIN_VERSION env var still overrides it for release builds
and for a local loop against a mavenLocal SNAPSHOT.
